tasks.short: Keep library accounts, invoices, and cash

steps.what: Perform accounting activities, bookkeeping, and handling cash
Maintaining financial records and budgeting totals
Prepare invoicing totals from stored lines
Review the invoice and the budget figures

tasks.design: The assistant does the bookkeeping, keeps financial records and budgeting totals, handles cash, and prepares invoices. {ERP} totals stored invoice lines. The assistant reviews the invoice against the budget note, and {EMAIL} sends only the accepted invoice. A blank line amount stays blank and nothing is sent. Cash stays in the assistant's hands.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant added invoice lines by hand and retyped the total.
tasks.enabler_now: Line amounts are stored, so the invoice total is a sum.
tasks.still_hard: Counting cash, and judging that the budget can bear the invoice, stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant will not send an invoice whose total they do not recognise.
tasks.altitude: Cash and budgeting stay. An invoice goes out only in the version the assistant accepted.

reach.task: Post the invoice into the ledger
reach.learn: Which totals finance will not accept from the desk.

evidence.claim: Stored invoice lines can be summed. A blank amount stops the invoice.
Sending an invoice asks someone to pay. The assistant accepts the total first. Cash handling is not automated.

assumptions: The work starts with cash or with invoice lines and ends with a counted till, a budget note, or a sent invoice.
An invoice line has description, quantity, and amount, entered by the assistant. A blank amount is not invented. Budget figures are the assistant's note, not a generated target.
The send uses the invoice accepted in the review. Cash time is not part of that send.
unknowns: Who may send an invoice, and to which bodies.
research_questions: How many invoices stopped on a blank line, and how often did the till not match?

already_counted.description: Handling cash and the bookkeeping around it is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a line amount the assistant has not yet accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: lines are incomplete and the till is the work, so invoices stay manual. High: complete lines are totaled and sent after review, and cash handling remains. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Operate audio-visual equipment for the session
Maintain the audio-visual equipment after use

tasks.design: The assistant operates and maintains audio-visual equipment for the session. Setup, running, and packing stay physical. No control is claimed from a remote system.
tasks.previous_blocker: The equipment is in the room, and it still is.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored field sets up the machine.
tasks.still_hard: Cables, sound, and the picture stay in the assistant's hands.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant stops the session when the equipment is not safe or not ready.
tasks.altitude: Nothing material changes. The assistant still runs the equipment.

reach.task: Say what the session must play
reach.learn: Which faults mean the session should stop.

evidence.claim: Operating and maintaining audio-visual equipment in the room is physical.

assumptions: The work starts before the session and ends when the equipment is packed away.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A fault log from another task is not this work.
unknowns: Which sessions the assistant is expected to run alone.
research_questions: How often did a session stop because the equipment failed?

already_counted.description: Operating the audio-visual equipment is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: running the equipment adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every session is still set up and run by hand. High: the same operation and maintenance remain. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the catalogue version before publication

tasks.design: The assistant designs and maintains the library's online catalogues. {CMS} publishes a catalogue only after the assistant accepts that version. Design and the decision to change a heading stay with the assistant. A blank heading is not published.
tasks.previous_blocker: The assistant edited the pages and published them in the same sitting, with no separate accepted version.
tasks.enabler_now: The page can be held until the assistant accepts that version.
tasks.still_hard: Designing the catalogue, and judging a heading, stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant will not publish a catalogue that shows the wrong holdings.
tasks.altitude: Design stays. Publication happens only for the catalogue version the assistant accepted.

reach.task: Approve a heading change the assistant will not make alone
reach.learn: Which headings are public and which are internal.

evidence.claim: A catalogue page can be published only after a person accepts that version. Designing the page stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a catalogue change and ends when the accepted version is published or the assistant stops.
The assistant edits heading, title list, and visible text. A blank required heading is not published.
Publication uses the version accepted in the review. A later edit voids it.
unknowns: Who else must see a public catalogue change before it goes live.
research_questions: How often did the review stop a publication?

already_counted.description: Designing the online catalogue is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a heading the assistant has not yet accepted for publication.

approvals.approved_version: online catalogue version the assistant accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: design work dominates, and pages are rarely ready to publish. High: ready pages are published after review, and design and maintenance remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check prices, figure costs, and prepare orders

steps.what: Checking prices of books, pamphlets, periodicals, and audio-visual supplies
Figuring costs to acquire other library materials
Preparing appropriate order forms from those prices
Review the order information before the ordering process
Providing the approved order information to others and facilitating the order

tasks.design: The assistant acquires books, pamphlets, periodicals, audio-visual materials, and other supplies by checking prices and figuring costs. {PROCUREMENT} reads a stored price and multiplies by the quantity onto an order form. The assistant reviews that form, and {EMAIL} sends only the accepted version to the person who places the order. A missing price or quantity stays blank and no form is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices were retyped onto each order form and the cost was figured by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A price row and a quantity are enough for a product and a sum.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what to acquire, and accepting the form, stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant will not send an order whose price they do not recognise.

ambition.what: A complete price can be on the order form while the decision to acquire is still the assistant's.

tasks.altitude: Arithmetic shrinks. The assistant still decides the order and still accepts the form.

reach.task: Decide a purchase above the desk's limit
reach.learn: Which orders the librarian must see first.

evidence.claim: A stored price and quantity can fill an order form and a cost. A missing price stops the form. Choosing what to acquire stays with the assistant.

assumptions: The work starts with a wanted item and ends when the accepted order is sent or the assistant stops.
A price row has item identifier, supplier, and unit price, maintained by the assistant or the supplier list. Quantity is entered by the assistant. A blank price or quantity is not invented.
The send uses the order form accepted in the review. The assistant's choice of what to acquire is not a formula.
unknowns: Who is allowed to place the order once the form is accepted.
research_questions: How many forms stopped on a blank price?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the order before it is sent is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct a price row the assistant finds out of date before accepting the form.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: prices are often missing, so the assistant still figures the order by hand. High: prices are present, the form is reviewed, and only then sent. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant still meets patrons, shelves items, and handles cash. A record, notice, invoice, or order is written or sent only after the assistant accepts that version.
reach: A librarian receives the question the assistant could not answer from the desk.
A finance colleague receives only an invoice the assistant has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required field is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep shelving, cash, and patron conversations in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every item on loan has a location and a due date the desk can trust, and the assistant still decides the exception.
